target_customer: South Asian women in the US buying or renting Indian wedding and occasion wear
problem: Indian wedding outfits are expensive, worn rarely and hard to find in the US; Riya Collective offered rental and consignment of designer Indian clothing.
business_model: Rental and consignment marketplace with a buy back program

founders.name: Sarina Siddhanti
founders.background_notes: YC page lists her with no bio.

founders.name: Arian Agrawal
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in the Green Queen article, which says they founded the company in April 2019 from their living room.

competitors.name: Rent the Runway (Sani line)
competitors.what: Mainstream fashion rental site that added South Asian formal wear from the label Sani in February 2020
competitors.traction_then: Started with three pieces, two lehengas and one anarkali
competitors.funding_then: Not stated in the cited article

technical_complexity.rationale: A rental e-commerce site with inventory and logistics; the hard parts are operations, not software.

defensibility.rationale: Curated inventory and community help, but a larger rental platform entered the same wedge in February 2020.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rent the Runway added Sani designs in February 2020; coverage noted it could eventually hurt independent Indian wear rental sites.

market_need_then: Green Queen (March 2020) describes demand for Indian wedding wear rental among South Asian women abroad; large events were then halted by COVID per later coverage.

branding.domain_note: riyacollective.com now redirects to a domain sales page (observed 2026).

identity.voice_and_tone: Community-driven, modern framing of Indian fashion per Product Hunt and press

branding.community_and_virality: Covered by KQED (January 2020), Green Queen and a Substack founder interview; a spring 2022 PR Newswire release announced two collections.

brand_strength.rationale: Some regional press and a clear niche positioning, but no mascot, memorable asset or evidence of word of mouth at scale.

outcome_analysis: Riya Collective rented and consigned Indian wedding wear in the US, took YC in Winter 2020 and was still issuing collections in spring 2022. It is now Inactive with its domain for sale, but no shutdown notice or reason was found, so no failure factors are assigned. Wedding seasons halted in 2020 per press, and Rent the Runway entered the niche in February 2020, but neither is sourced as the cause of closure.
notes: Green Queen says the $150,000 came from Y Combinator and gives no funding date; the March 2020 date comes from the article date (March 5, 2020) and CB Insights, which lists the round on March 17, 2020 with South Park Commons as investor. This is likely the standard YC deal and rests on one outlet plus one database. A CB Insights description of Riya Collective as a gambling platform is treated as a data error. Founder education and prior employers were not found in opened sources. Sources are founded April 2019 per Green Queen. Cause of Inactive status is not public.
